_description: Historical disaster event database for CLIP-based similarity retrieval. 30 curated events across 5 categories, India-focused with major global events.

events.name: Kerala Floods
events.description: Worst flooding in Kerala in nearly a century, triggered by unusually high rainfall during the monsoon season. All 14 districts were placed on red alert.
events.wikipedia_search: 2018 Kerala floods satellite image

events.name: Chennai Floods
events.description: Severe urban flooding caused by record rainfall, submerging large parts of Chennai and surrounding districts. Airport operations were suspended for over a week.
events.wikipedia_search: 2015 South India floods Chennai aerial

events.name: Assam Floods
events.description: Annual Brahmaputra river flooding affecting 32 of 35 districts in Assam, displacing millions and inundating the Kaziranga National Park.
events.wikipedia_search: 2022 Assam floods Brahmaputra inundation satellite

events.name: Bihar Floods
events.description: Catastrophic flooding in northern Bihar triggered by heavy rains in Nepal and overflowing of the Bagmati, Kosi, and Gandak rivers.
events.wikipedia_search: 2019 Bihar floods aerial inundation

events.name: Pakistan Super Floods
events.description: The most devastating floods in Pakistan's history, affecting one-fifth of the country's total land area and impacting 20 million people.
events.wikipedia_search: 2010 Pakistan floods satellite NASA

events.name: Uttarakhand Flash Floods
events.description: Catastrophic cloudbursts triggered flash floods and landslides in the Himalayan state, devastating the Kedarnath valley. Often called the Himalayan Tsunami.
events.wikipedia_search: 2013 Uttarakhand floods Kedarnath destruction aerial

events.name: Uttarakhand Forest Fires
events.description: Widespread forest fires across Uttarakhand consuming thousands of hectares of forest cover during the dry summer months.
events.wikipedia_search: 2021 Uttarakhand forest fire smoke aerial ISRO

events.name: Himachal Pradesh Forest Fires
events.description: Widespread forest fires across Shimla, Kullu, and Mandi districts during extended dry spell, destroying pine and oak forests.
events.wikipedia_search: 2023 Himachal Pradesh forest fire

events.name: Australian Black Summer Bushfires
events.location: New South Wales and Victoria, Australia
events.description: The most destructive bushfire season in Australia's recorded history, burning over 18.6 million hectares and destroying over 3,000 homes.
events.wikipedia_search: 2019 Australian bushfires aerial NASA satellite smoke

events.name: California Camp Fire
events.description: The deadliest and most destructive wildfire in California history, completely destroying the town of Paradise and burning 153,336 acres.
events.wikipedia_search: 2018 California Camp Fire Paradise aerial satellite

events.name: Canada Wildfire Season
events.description: Record-breaking Canadian wildfire season burning over 18 million hectares, forcing mass evacuations and blanketing North American cities in smoke.
events.wikipedia_search: 2023 Canada wildfire satellite smoke aerial

events.name: Nepal Earthquake (Gorkha)
events.description: A 7.8 magnitude earthquake struck central Nepal, causing widespread destruction in Kathmandu and surrounding districts. Triggered deadly avalanches on Mount Everest.
events.wikipedia_search: 2015 Nepal earthquake Kathmandu destruction aerial satellite

events.name: Bhuj Earthquake (Gujarat)
events.description: A 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck Bhuj on Republic Day morning, causing catastrophic destruction across Kutch district. One of India's deadliest natural disasters.
events.wikipedia_search: 2001 Gujarat earthquake Bhuj rubble aerial satellite ISRO

events.name: Turkey-Syria Earthquake
events.description: Twin 7.8 and 7.7 magnitude earthquakes struck southeastern Turkey and northern Syria, causing catastrophic building collapses across both countries.
events.wikipedia_search: 2023 Turkey Syria earthquake building collapse aerial satellite

events.name: Japan Tōhoku Earthquake and Tsunami
events.description: A 9.0 magnitude undersea megathrust earthquake off the coast of Japan, triggering a devastating tsunami that reached heights of up to 40.5 metres.
events.wikipedia_search: 2011 Tohoku earthquake tsunami aerial satellite NASA

events.name: Haiti Earthquake
events.description: A catastrophic 7.0 magnitude earthquake near Port-au-Prince caused unprecedented urban destruction in one of the world's poorest nations.
events.wikipedia_search: 2010 Haiti earthquake Port-au-Prince aerial destruction satellite

events.name: Kedarnath Landslide
events.description: Massive landslides triggered by the Uttarakhand flood disaster buried the Kedarnath pilgrim route and surrounding villages in metres of debris and rock.
events.wikipedia_search: 2013 Kedarnath landslide debris aerial satellite

events.name: Wayanad Landslides
events.description: A series of devastating landslides triggered by heavy monsoon rainfall buried villages in Mundakkai and Chooralmala, causing one of Kerala's worst disaster tragedies.
events.wikipedia_search: 2024 Wayanad landslide Mundakkai aerial satellite

events.name: Himachal Pradesh Landslides
events.location: Shimla, Mandi, Kullu – Himachal Pradesh, India
events.description: Widespread landslides triggered by heavy monsoon rainfall blocked national highways, destroyed roads, and caused significant loss of life across multiple districts.
events.wikipedia_search: 2023 Himachal Pradesh landslide road blocked aerial

events.name: Taliye Landslide
events.description: A sudden and catastrophic landslide triggered by extreme rainfall buried Taliye village almost entirely, with very few survivors.
events.wikipedia_search: 2021 Maharashtra Taliye landslide Raigad aerial

events.name: Aranayake Landslide
events.description: A major landslide buried several villages in Kegalle district of Sri Lanka following heavy monsoon rains, trapping hundreds of residents.
events.wikipedia_search: 2016 Sri Lanka Aranayake landslide aerial

events.name: Cyclone Amphan
events.description: An extremely severe cyclonic storm that made landfall near Sagar Island, West Bengal, causing catastrophic destruction to Kolkata and coastal districts. The strongest cyclone to strike the Bay of Bengal since 1999.
events.wikipedia_search: Cyclone Amphan 2020 satellite eye storm India

events.name: Cyclone Fani
events.description: An extremely severe cyclonic storm that struck Odisha near Puri with wind speeds of 175–185 km/h. Mass evacuation of 1.2 million people is credited with minimising casualties.
events.wikipedia_search: Cyclone Fani 2019 satellite eye storm Odisha

events.name: Cyclone Yaas
events.description: A very severe cyclonic storm that made landfall near Balasore, Odisha. Coinciding with a high tide, it caused severe storm surge flooding along the coastline.
events.wikipedia_search: Cyclone Yaas 2021 satellite storm West Bengal

events.name: Cyclone Tauktae
events.description: An extremely severe cyclonic storm tracking along the west coast of India, making landfall in Gujarat with sustained winds of 185 km/h. Strongest cyclone to affect the region since 1998.
events.wikipedia_search: Cyclone Tauktae 2021 satellite eye Gujarat ISRO

events.name: Cyclone Biparjoy
events.description: An extremely severe cyclonic storm that intensified over the Arabian Sea and made landfall near Jakhau Port, Gujarat, after a prolonged lifespan of nearly two weeks.
events.wikipedia_search: Cyclone Biparjoy 2023 satellite Gujarat Arabian Sea

events.name: Cyclone Phailin
events.description: A very severe cyclonic storm that made landfall near Gopalpur, Odisha, with wind speeds exceeding 200 km/h. A pre-disaster evacuation of nearly one million people significantly reduced casualties.
events.wikipedia_search: Cyclone Phailin 2013 satellite Bay of Bengal Odisha

events.name: Cyclone Idai
events.description: One of the worst tropical cyclones on record to affect Africa, making landfall near Beira, Mozambique. Caused catastrophic flooding and wind damage across three nations.
events.wikipedia_search: Cyclone Idai 2019 satellite Mozambique Beira flooding

events.name: Odisha Floods
events.description: Heavy monsoon rains and dam releases from the Hirakud reservoir triggered widespread flooding across Mahanadi basin districts in Odisha.
events.wikipedia_search: 2020 Odisha floods Mahanadi inundation aerial

events.name: Greece Wildfires (Evia)
events.description: Catastrophic wildfires during an extreme heat wave burned over 100,000 hectares across mainland Greece and the island of Evia, described as the worst natural disaster in Greece's modern history.
events.wikipedia_search: 2021 Greece wildfires Evia satellite aerial smoke
